plugins.maa_adapter.edit.maaAdapterSuppo: The MAA adapter supports emulators only; use a general script for the PC version.
plugins.maa_adapter.edit.maaAnnihilation: A separate MAA session that only wakes the client and runs annihilation; it does not continue into the daily tasks.
Annihilation only starts once this weekday is reached; once the weekly cap is hit, later runs are skipped.
plugins.maa_adapter.edit.maaConfigRestor: Backups of the MAA native config; restoring applies directly to MAA itself. Created automatically (dedup) when opening this edit page, before running MAA or opening its config UI, latest 10 kept

plugins.maa_adapter.edit.maaCultivateMan: Requires a Skland binding. Enabling immediately adds Elite 2 Lv. 1 and skill level 7 goals for owned operators, then checks for new operators before every development run. Lower-rarity operators use available limits. Completed goals are skipped and existing operator goals are preserved. Disabling only stops automatic additions and keeps current settings. Execution follows this page’s development and auto-raise settings.
Management was saved, but goals could not be reloaded. Refresh the page to view them.
plugins.maa_adapter.edit.maaCultivateMas: Mastery requires skill rank 7. Selecting a mastery target automatically sets the skill rank target to 7; clearing the mastery target leaves the skill rank target unchanged.

plugins.maa_adapter.edit.maaCultivateRec: Progression and inventory rely on MAA in-run recognition. After binding Skland you can set skill rank, mastery, and module goals, and existing goals stay read-only before binding. Operators with no settable goals are hidden from the selector automatically.

plugins.maa_adapter.edit.maaGreenTicketS: Starts its own MAA session once a month, before annihilation, buying everything on the 1st floor plus Headhunting Permits and Recruitment Permits on the 2nd floor. Skipped once bought this month, and a failure does not affect the later tasks. Requires MAA v6.3.0 or newer
